overview: The Committee of the Whole held its second preliminary budget meeting for Fiscal Year 2027 to review departmental operations and funding requirements. The committee discussed budget proposals for Human Resources, the Council on Aging, Diversity, Equity and Inclusion, and Recreation, ultimately keeping the matter in committee.

items.title: Human Resources Budget Review
items.summary: Director Lisa Crowley presented budget increases for training and subscriptions necessitated by the expiration of ARPA funds and updated the council on the city-wide compensation and classification study. The council requested a follow-up meeting to review the 60 documents comprising the full study and its proposed salary realignments.

items.title: Council on Aging Budget Review
items.summary: Director Pam Kelly detailed a slight budget increase to expand social worker hours from 25 to 30 per week and noted the success of food pantry and grab-and-go meal programs. A long-term goal for the department includes conducting a feasibility study for a new senior center facility.

items.title: Diversity, Equity and Inclusion Budget Review
items.summary: Director Frances Nwajei discussed budget adjustments for staffing and event costs as ARPA funding ends and emphasized compliance with upcoming federal web accessibility guidelines. The department is also overseeing Americans with Disabilities Act compliance for City Hall renovations and new private developments.

items.title: Recreation Department Budget Review
items.summary: Director Kevin Bailey reported on expanding teen programming and rink revenue via online booking apps while addressing significant water damage issues affecting the recreation center's gym floor. Councilors discussed the difficulty of filling a part-time office manager position and advocated for future investment in permanent park restrooms.

items.title: Budget Calendar and Meeting Scheduling
items.summary: The committee and the Chief of Staff coordinated upcoming meeting dates for the remainder of the budget season and discussed the transmission of departmental data to the council.
